scope: Installed CLI source/settings and controlled benchmark launch; no model calls or account mutation
builtInAutomaticLongTermMemory: No built-in durable automatic long-term memory setting/engine identified in reviewed settings, resource-loader, session and CLI sources. No memory-off flag is invented. This is a version-scoped source audit, not a universal claim about extensions.

officialProjectContext.semantics: Reads existing project/global context into system prompt, not automatic memory generation. --no-context-files is symmetric benchmark isolation, not evidence of disabling an automatic memory engine.

extensions.semantics: noExtensions keeps only explicit CLI extension paths. Candidate uses --no-extensions and no explicit -e/--extension; --no-mcp also disables built-in MCP resources. Thus custom memory-writing extensions are excluded in this controlled experiment; production defaults are not changed.

compaction.semantics: Normal same-session compaction retained with original settings on both paid arms; no task/turn rotation.

cacheWarming.candidatePaidPolicy: Preserve original. All observed attempts counted. Extra responses lacking reconciled usage make coverage unknown; never assume prewarm free.
